home.text: class=""> FREE ESTIMATE We produce the best basement finishes, home remodels, home theaters, & additions in Utah. Serving most of Utah, Salt Lake, and Davis counties Custom Homes, Finishing Basements & Remodeling Homes RWK Construction makes YOUR vision a reality by first offering you a FREE consultation and estimate. Our estimator will meet with you at your home to discuss your ideas and vision. Then a customized plan will be created uniquely fitting your vision. Our Services Photo Galleries Basements Theater Rooms Custom Homes See All Galleries Testimonials I got my basement finished with RWK recently. A huge shout out to our construction manager Jeff, who was a genuine rockstar. He was extremely responsive, provided very thoughtful feedback, and made sure that we were 100% satisfied as a customer. I will be reaching out to RWK and Jeff again if I need more construction work done. Five stars and two thumbs up!! Dok Kwon I would give 100 stars if I could! We had a wonderful experience start to finish with RWK. Very responsive, explained everything clearly and thoroughly. Finished on schedule. We always knew what was going on and what the status of our basement finishing project was. Jeff took over our project and he is simply the best! He went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect. I can’t recommend them enough! Lindsey Castleberry RWK is a step above the rest! From the very first interaction they were professional partners and were focused on a solid customer experience. James was an amazing estimator that worked and partnered with us and provided amazing recommendations. Pricing was fantastic and truly worth every bit of the cost. Taylor our Project Manager has truly provided the best customer experience we have ever had. He arrived when he said he would, checked with us daily, partnered with us to save where we could and make changes as needed. He is always professional. Our basement was fully finished well ahead of schedule and the entire RWK team were amazing. They hire only the best contractors and truly make each step fun and take out the stress. All kidding aside, if you don’t use RWK then you are just asking for a headache. They will give you the highest quality experience and treat you like family. Any future projects we have will only be sent to them. Thanks again!!!! Mark “BurgerMeister” RWK Construction transformed my poorly finished basement into a beautiful, comfortable place for my family to enjoy. I was impressed with the professionalism of the ladies I spoke to on the phone to schedule an estimate. I was even more impressed when James arrived on time to walk the project and get the info he needed to create an estimate for me. James had very helpful ideas, was very professional, and got the estimate to me exactly when he said he would. Our main project manager, Jeff, was also amazing. He was actively involved in making our project a success. His hard work, attention to detail, and professionalism were very impressive. I would absolutely recommend RWK Construction after my experience with them! Andrea Breitling We have loved our experience with RWK. Communication was always excellent, the subs were great and cleaned up their mess along the way. Our basement was finished a month before estimated timeframe! Have zero complaints. Would highly recommend or use again. Ally Knudsen We are SO glad we decided to go with RWK! They finished our basement and did some repairs and remodeling on our main floor. We got multiple bids and met with quite a few other contractors before choosing RWK and we haven't regretted that decision once. We'd previously had a negative experience with someone we hired to do some work on our house, which made us wary. RWK really seems to understand and appreciate what a big deal it is to trust them with your home. They were respectful of our time, our property, and our budget. Our project manager, Taylor, is AWESOME. He was great at keeping us in the loop, answering questions, and promptly dealing with anything that came up. Our project had some small hiccups, like all projects do, but everything was handled well. We were impressed with all of the subs - they're professional, do quality work, and are just all around great people. We've already recommended RWK to family, friends, and neighbors. We're looking forward to working with RWK again for phase II of our renovation! They're the BEST. Tracy Stewart We can't speak highly enough of our experience with RWK. We had reviewed and analyzed for months different contractors specializing in basements. We received multiple quotes and met with multiple GC’s and finally decided on RWK. From day one ‘over communicating’ and clearly explaining expectations and next steps were part of their process, from our project manager, Eric. He is attentive and pleasant to work with. Their app is amazing! Being able to look at the schedule and know who is coming really helped to understand each step and put our minds at ease. It allowed us to schedule our day and not be inconvenienced. The estimate was fair and we stayed within it, except for a few upgrades. They also finished well before the estimated completion date! We would recommend working with RWK. They did an excellent job in finishing our basement! Amy & Jon Godfrey Amy Godfrey I had RWK construction finish my basement for me. They were fabulous. I really enjoyed working with them. Taylor was my project manager. He kept me informed about everything that was going on. He let me know if there would be any changes to the schedule so that there would be no surprises. They actually finished ahead of schedule and under budget. My favorite part is the French doors leading into the master bedroom. It is beautiful. It’s the first thing that all my friends and neighbors have commented on. I wasn’t sure what I wanted done and they gave me suggestions on some things that I could do to make it look better. I ended up putting in a laundry room in the basement. Glad they suggested it to me. I also put in a dry bar so that when I have guests they can have a place to make meals and have a little more privacy. It includes a mini fridge, toaster, and a microwave. All of their subcontractors were very knowledgeable and did excellent work. I was very impressed with everyone that worked on my house. I have nothing but good things to say about this company. I will recommend them to all my friends and family. Bonnie Meldrum RWK has been excellent to work with. Our project Manager was Henry. He was very knowledgeable, responsive and flexible as we worked through a custom home theater build. He did a great job of coordinating all the different elements of the project and communicating with us. He worked with us to adjust the timeline several times due to supply chain delays (not fault of RWK… just nature of current supply chain environment). We would definitely recommend them to anyone doing a home theater build out. J.J. Phillips We contracted with RWK to finish the family/entertainment room in our basement and redo the floors and paint in the basement entryway. We're thrilled with the results so far and are excited to get started on the second phase of the project - remodeling our kitchen, new paint, refinished hardwood and new carpet on the upper two levels. Our project manager Taylor has been great to work with and keeps us updated on each step of the project. Their subcontractors have done a great job overall, and all have been quick to respond to any change requests we've made. We'll definitely use them again when needed and will recommend to friends and family! Kelly D Wanlass Just finished our basement finishing project. Very pleased with the final result. The process was a bit of a nightmare at times, but I don't fault RWK for all of that. We chose a good time (pandemic, rising prices, high demand and low supply, etc.) to start the project. Ended up twice as long as originally planned and it was definitely a rocky start... That said, however, Ryan was responsive, open to our feedback, quick to address concerns we expressed, and in the end did everything to make sure we felt fairly treated. Project started off with not much in the way of project management. I brought the issue up to Ryan who was quick to respond and address the issue. Our new project manager, Henry, responded quickly to our questions and whenever we noted issues from any of the subs' work. He made sure we were pleased with each step and brought back the subs as many times as was needed to make everything perfect, and even stepped in to do things himself, as needed, to move things along. I'm sure he's just as glad to be done with this project as we are! I'd recommend RWK for their dedication to their work and to their customers and to making sure their customers are 100% satisfied before signing off on the project -- and for still responding quickly thereafter when we noticed an issue and reached out to get that touched up. Kyle Swenson After reviewing several contractors (Around 7) and getting bids from all of them for a basement finish I went with RWK because of the professionalism and good reputation that they had. I was not disappointed with my choice at all. They were very competitive with their bid and came in better than other contractors I had come out. THEY WERE AWESOME. Our project manager Taylor was amazing to work with. He was very dedicated to our project, and texted us each day to check if we had any questions. I loved how Taylor kept us updated and always made sure we were happy with the results. Taylor made the process simple, fast and the end result was amazing. I had a custom theater put in and was pretty picky with things and He was always patient and understanding. I HIGHLY recommend Taylor and RWK. They started and finished on schedule, and under budget. If you are looking to finish a basement, let me save you some time from getting bids from other companies and just go with RWK, you will not be disappointed. Kyle McArthur We hired RWK to finish our basement earlier this year and could not have been more happy with the job. Not only were they great to work with and communicate with (our rep was Taylor), but they have awesome subs that do the same. We even had them build us a pretty intense playroom area with only a paper sketch to go off (see picture) and it turned out incredible. And after it was all said and done they came in under budget. If you want a company that does a good job, finishes when they say they will, and doesn't gouge you, these are the guys. Spencer Mecham I didn't actually use this company (they don't do the type of blockwork I was looking for), but they responded to my voicemail regardless during an EXTREMELY busy year and let me know. I appreciate that kind of professionalism. Cal Erstein Before hiring Ryan to do our basement we got 2 other bids. He was the lowest and his bid was the most detailed. He took the time to explain where we could save money, what would work, and what wouldn't. He finished a little under budget and on time. Ryan,Trevor, and their whole crew was very professional and responsive. There was some minor hiccups during the process but they responded quicky and without inconvenience to us. It was worth the money to have a professional contractor handle our project. The end result was everything we expected and more. We will enjoy our space for many years to come. We highly recommend Ryan and his team! Update: We moved. During the process of selling our home we got many compliments on our finished basement. Our new place had an unfinished basement and we only called RWK to come out and give us a bid. Again he was very thorough and gave us a detailed quote. We were a little hesitant when he assigned us a new project manager (Henry), but after the first meeting with him any worries that we had were gone. Henry is awesome. He would provide weekly updates in person, he also texted often; the lines of communication were always open. The project took a little longer than scheduled due to inventory issues. In the end we have a beautiful basement and so glad we went with RWK again. Seth Chhour RWK finished the basement in our brand new home, building me the perfect "Mother-in-law" apartment. Overall the contractors were professional and did good work, I was very impressed with how consistently and well they cleaned up after themselves. They were very adaptable to making changes when requested. Trevor was easy to work with and followed up to make sure things were done right. The job took a few weeks longer than estimated but considering the work was done during the pandemic lock down, things went fairly smoothly. The quality of the work done in our basement makes us wish they had finished the main floor as well. It has been 9 months since they finished the basement and they have had to come back to fix a few things, no problem. They are as good as their word on the warranty, I feel my money was well spent going with RWK. Janeen Viles I spent years thinking about our basement. By the time I finally requested estimates, my plan had become fairly "creative" and grandiose. I wanted a bathroom where the storage closet was, a soundproof office, custom range hood, and much, much more! I expected Ryan to tell me my ideas were too ambitious or not feasible, but that was not the case! Every idea was executed and I am so happy with the final product! James was the project manager assigned to our basement. He has great communication skills and went above and beyond to address all the little things that would have driven me nuts for years. I really appreciate James' attention to detail. He fixed so many things that other contractors would have rolled their eyes at (e.g. broken window screens, etc.). James never made me feel like I was annoying or nit-picky. He validated my concerns and then made it right! I am so glad we went with RWK! Becky Tehero We recommend RWK to everyone now. Ryan was very detailed in his estimate and was right on in the final cost of finishing our Basement. If we hadn’t upgraded a few things we would have come in under budget. Jeff Rogers is the best Project Manager on the team. He is super fun and our new best friend. His planning was on point, detailed and very responsive. He has the best personality and brings light and fun to our day every time he comes around. We are looking into featuring our house on the parade of homes. That’s how good RWK construction is. And we have a pretty “normal” home but it feels like a million dollar home!!! Jason Weber Working with RWK construction was a delight. Since basements aren’t typically finished for you in Utah, my husband and I searched for a construction company that would do the work for us. We got our quote and mock up of the basement in a very timely manner. We were told the project would take 3 months to complete. From there, we put down the initial deposit and were introduced to our project manager Jeff Rogers. To say that Jeff was the best part of our experience would be an understatement! He was very communicative, helpful and nice. He is truly wonderful at his job. Each morning we got a text update from him with what to expect for that day and the timing. We were always in the loop with the progress the whole time. Jeff covered every question and thought of everything. What sort of lights we wanted, what tile, even down the the grout color. We never had to stress or worry about what was being done or who was doing what. Jeff scheduled professional contractors who did a fantastic job at being respectful of our house while getting their work done efficiently. He also handled all the permits with the city. Overall, this was the best experience we have ever had working with a construction company. Our basement finished a month ahead of schedule. It’s exactly what we wanted and then some. I keep walking down there and admiring the outstanding work. :) My husband and I highly recommend RWK construction for any project you need! If you get to pick your project manager, ask for Jeff Rogers. Shelbi Schollenberger RWK Construction really exceeded our expectations. We wanted to finish our basement, but we weren’t ready to do the project ourselves. We received multiple bids and after meeting with all the companies and receiving quotes, the choice was an easy one. They weren’t the cheapest or the most expensive, but we could tell from the beginning they were the clear choice. Ryan seemed honest and easy to work with. After speaking to Ryan, Taylor was assigned to be our project manager. He was fantastic and we had daily communication through text and calls with him about the plans for the day and week. There is also a calendar in their app that lists when subs are coming. They worked well with the subs and they all came when expected. If we ever had a problem, Taylor would address it immediately and provide us with an answer. Ryan was also available to us through the project if needed, but we rarely spoke with him because Taylor was so attentive. If we found any issues (big or very tiny) Taylor took them seriously and made sure we were 100% happy. One of our favorite things about the process is the subs enter into basement through a window (framers, dry wall, all of it!). It was nice to not have to worry when to be home and have others coming in an out. There were many days we had no idea they were there. The subs we did meet were respectful and we could tell they value their relationship with RWK. We have been so pleased have referred others to use them as well. Our basement is beautiful and we couldn’t be happier. We felt like Ryan and Taylor really valued our wants and opinions and did everything in their power to make us happy. We had heard stories of contractors being difficult, but we truly experienced the opposite. We would use them again without any thought! Tori Peay RWK just wrapped up getting our basement finished and we are very very happy with how everything turned out. From start to finish, everyone on the RWK team was so responsive and ready to help us look for the best options for what we wanted to accomplish. Ryan gave us a detailed and fair estimate. We had a few groups bid out the project, and for all comparable pricing, we felt like RWKs included the most quality and personalized work. James helped us get a great time frame set up and really got the ball rolling on the project. Jeff Rogers who was our main contact and project manager was so on top of every detail. Anytime there was any question, concern, or adjustment, Jeff was all over it. He paid close attention to making sure each aspect of our basement was just the way we wanted it. Lastly, it’s worth mentioning how great all the subcontractors were. From the built in reading nook, to the theater room sound dampening, the kitchenette, the painters, framers, flooring, etc etc - we felt like every group really did such quality work and were very open to chatting with us directly about specific requests. When you put so much time, money, and stress into projects like this, you really hope things all come together just the way you dream and we honestly felt like they did. Thanks RWK for taking great care of us. We recommend you highly!!! Mindy Perez We have now used RWK twice. They finished our basement last year (it's beautiful and holding up super well!) and this year we had them come out and do an office install (cabinets, paint, frame in new french doors, electrical in cabinets, etc.) and add some finishing touches to our living room (built ins and shiplap on the fireplace). They are fabulous! Ryan is an honest outstanding guy who we trust and would use time and time again. For this particular project, James was our project manager and he was outstanding! He would text me each morning asking if I had questions or concerns, he kept me up to date on scheduling, he went to bat for me when I had issues with subcontractors, and was patient with my picky self. H

This is the time to bring your photos, floorplans, Pinterest boards and any other wish list ideas you want to incorporate into your dream home. Let’s take this opportunity to get to know each other, discuss pricing, and determine if we’re the right for you! Design Do you already have the design you're looking for? You’ll also be able to stay on top of expenses and when your payments are due. You can easily contact us through the portal and we’ll get back to you right away. Construction Once we've got your design all squared away & your own profile set up on our Homeowner Portal, we'll be ready to start construction. Our team keeps the communication lines open and transparent to all parties. You'll be in good hands when working with RWK Construction Co. Finishing Up As we get close to finishing up the project, we’ll meet with you once more to address any questions or concerns you may have. At this time we’ll discuss our warranty process in the case that any issues arise with your home after we leave. Post-Completion Your space is now ready to enjoy, show off, and make memories for years to come. RWK Construction Co is grateful for the opportunity to work with you and we thank you for choosing to Build the Right Way!

testimonials.title: Testimonials – RWK Construction Co. | RWK Construction Co.
testimonials.text: class="site-content"> Testimonials After reviewing several contractors (Around 7) and getting bids from all of them for a basement finish I went with RWK because of the professionalism and good reputation that they had. I was not disappointed with my choice at all. They were very competitive with their bid and came in better than other contractors I had come out. THEY WERE AWESOME. Our project manager Taylor was amazing to work with. He was very dedicated to our project, and texted us each day to check if we had any questions. I loved how Taylor kept us updated and always made sure we were happy with the results. Taylor made the process simple, fast and the end result was amazing. I had a custom theater put in and was pretty picky with things and He was always patient and understanding. I HIGHLY recommend Taylor and RWK. They started and finished on schedule, and under budget. If you are looking to finish a basement, let me save you some time from getting bids from other companies and just go with RWK, you will not be disappointed. - Kyle McArthur We have now used RWK twice. They finished our basement last year (it's beautiful and holding up super well!) and this year we had them come out and do an office install (cabinets, paint, frame in new french doors, electrical in cabinets, etc.) and add some finishing touches to our living room (built ins and shiplap on the fireplace). They are fabulous! Ryan is an honest outstanding guy who we trust and would use time and time again. For this particular project, James was our project manager and he was outstanding! He would text me each morning asking if I had questions or concerns, he kept me up to date on scheduling, he went to bat for me when I had issues with subcontractors, and was patient with my picky self. He was always available when needed, stopped by often to check in on things and is a very personable guy. The project went longer than expected, but a lot of that was my fault in wanting particular materials that weren't in stock and wanting things perfect. The finished project is exactly what I had envisioned and I am very pleased! Well worth the wait! - Nicole Barber RWK just wrapped up getting our basement finished and we are very very happy with how everything turned out. From start to finish, everyone on the RWK team was so responsive and ready to help us look for the best options for what we wanted to accomplish. Ryan gave us a detailed and fair estimate. We had a few groups bid out the project, and for all comparable pricing, we felt like RWKs included the most quality and personalized work. James helped us get a great time frame set up and really got the ball rolling on the project. Jeff Rogers who was our main contact and project manager was so on top of every detail. Anytime there was any question, concern, or adjustment, Jeff was all over it. He paid close attention to making sure each aspect of our basement was just the way we wanted it. Lastly, it’s worth mentioning how great all the subcontractors were. From the built in reading nook, to the theater room sound dampening, the kitchenette, the painters, framers, flooring, etc etc - we felt like every group really did such quality work and were very open to chatting with us directly about specific requests. When you put so much time, money, and stress into projects like this, you really hope things all come together just the way you dream and we honestly felt like they did. Thanks RWK for taking great care of us. We recommend you highly!!! - Mindy Perez RWK Construction really exceeded our expectations. We wanted to finish our basement, but we weren’t ready to do the project ourselves. We received multiple bids and after meeting with all the companies and receiving quotes, the choice was an easy one. They weren’t the cheapest or the most expensive, but we could tell from the beginning they were the clear choice. Ryan seemed honest and easy to work with. After speaking to Ryan, Taylor was assigned to be our project manager. He was fantastic and we had daily communication through text and calls with him about the plans for the day and week. There is also a calendar in their app that lists when subs are coming. They worked well with the subs and they all came when expected. If we ever had a problem, Taylor would address it immediately and provide us with an answer. Ryan was also available to us through the project if needed, but we rarely spoke with him because Taylor was so attentive. If we found any issues (big or very tiny) Taylor took them seriously and made sure we were 100% happy. One of our favorite things about the process is the subs enter into basement through a window (framers, dry wall, all of it!). It was nice to not have to worry when to be home and have others coming in an out. There were many days we had no idea they were there. The subs we did meet were respectful and we could tell they value their relationship with RWK. We have been so pleased have referred others to use them as well. Our basement is beautiful and we couldn’t be happier. We felt like Ryan and Taylor really valued our wants and opinions and did everything in their power to make us happy. We had heard stories of contractors being difficult, but we truly experienced the opposite. We would use them again without any thought! - Tori Peay Working with RWK construction was a delight. Since basements aren’t typically finished for you in Utah, my husband and I searched for a construction company that would do the work for us. We got our quote and mock up of the basement in a very timely manner. We were told the project would take 3 months to complete. From there, we put down the initial deposit and were introduced to our project manager Jeff Rogers. To say that Jeff was the best part of our experience would be an understatement! He was very communicative, helpful and nice. He is truly wonderful at his job. Each morning we got a text update from him with what to expect for that day and the timing. We were always in the loop with the progress the whole time. Jeff covered every question and thought of everything. What sort of lights we wanted, what tile, even down the the grout color. We never had to stress or worry about what was being done or who was doing what. Jeff scheduled professional contractors who did a fantastic job at being respectful of our house while getting their work done efficiently. He also handled all the permits with the city. Overall, this was the best experience we have ever had working with a construction company. Our basement finished a month ahead of schedule. It’s exactly what we wanted and then some. I keep walking down there and admiring the outstanding work. :) My husband and I highly recommend RWK construction for any project you need! If you get to pick your project manager, ask for Jeff Rogers. - Shelbi Schollenberger We recommend RWK to everyone now. Ryan was very detailed in his estimate and was right on in the final cost of finishing our Basement. If we hadn’t upgraded a few things we would have come in under budget. Jeff Rogers is the best Project Manager on the team. He is super fun and our new best friend. His planning was on point, detailed and very responsive. He has the best personality and brings light and fun to our day every time he comes around. We are looking into featuring our house on the parade of homes. That’s how good RWK construction is. And we have a pretty “normal” home but it feels like a million dollar home!!! - Jason Weber I spent years thinking about our basement. By the time I finally requested estimates, my plan had become fairly "creative" and grandiose. I wanted a bathroom where the storage closet was, a soundproof office, custom range hood, and much, much more! I expected Ryan to tell me my ideas were too ambitious or not feasible, but that was not the case! Every idea was executed and I am so happy with the final product! James was the project manager assigned to our basement. He has great communication skills and went above and beyond to address all the little things that would have driven me nuts for years. I really appreciate James' attention to detail. He fixed so many things that other contractors would have rolled their eyes at (e.g. broken window screens, etc.). James never made me feel like I was annoying or nit-picky. He validated my concerns and then made it right! I am so glad we went with RWK! - Becky Tehero RWK finished the basement in our brand new home, building me the perfect "Mother-in-law" apartment. Overall the contractors were professional and did good work, I was very impressed with how consistently and well they cleaned up after themselves. They were very adaptable to making changes when requested. Trevor was easy to work with and followed up to make sure things were done right. The job took a few weeks longer than estimated but considering the work was done during the pandemic lock down, things went fairly smoothly. The quality of the work done in our basement makes us wish they had finished the main floor as well. It has been 9 months since they finished the basement and they have had to come back to fix a few things, no problem. They are as good as their word on the warranty, I feel my money was well spent going with RWK. - Janeen Viles Before hiring Ryan to do our basement we got 2 other bids. He was the lowest and his bid was the most detailed. He took the time to explain where we could save money, what would work, and what wouldn't. He finished a little under budget and on time. Ryan,Trevor, and their whole crew was very professional and responsive. There was some minor hiccups during the process but they responded quicky and without inconvenience to us. It was worth the money to have a professional contractor handle our project. The end result was everything we expected and more. We will enjoy our space for many years to come. We highly recommend Ryan and his team! Update: We moved. During the process of selling our home we got many compliments on our finished basement. Our new place had an unfinished basement and we only called RWK to come out and give us a bid. Again he was very thorough and gave us a detailed quote. We were a little hesitant when he assigned us a new project manager (Henry), but after the first meeting with him any worries that we had were gone. Henry is awesome. He would provide weekly updates in person, he also texted often; the lines of communication were always open. The project took a little longer than scheduled due to inventory issues. In the end we have a beautiful basement and so glad we went with RWK again. - Seth Chhour I didn't actually use this company (they don't do the type of blockwork I was looking for), but they responded to my voicemail regardless during an EXTREMELY busy year and let me know. I appreciate that kind of professionalism. - Cal Erstein We hired RWK to finish our basement earlier this year and could not have been more happy with the job. Not only were they great to work with and communicate with (our rep was Taylor), but they have awesome subs that do the same. We even had them build us a pretty intense playroom area with only a paper sketch to go off (see picture) and it turned out incredible. And after it was all said and done they came in under budget. If you want a company that does a good job, finishes when they say they will, and doesn't gouge you, these are the guys. - Spencer Mecham I got my basement finished with RWK recently. A huge shout out to our construction manager Jeff, who was a genuine rockstar. He was extremely responsive, provided very thoughtful feedback, and made sure that we were 100% satisfied as a customer. I will be reaching out to RWK and Jeff again if I need more construction work done. Five stars and two thumbs up!! - Dok Kwon Just finished our basement finishing project. Very pleased with the final result. The process was a bit of a nightmare at times, but I don't fault RWK for all of that. We chose a good time (pandemic, rising prices, high demand and low supply, etc.) to start the project. Ended up twice as long as originally planned and it was definitely a rocky start... That said, however, Ryan was responsive, open to our feedback, quick to address concerns we expressed, and in the end did everything to make sure we felt fairly treated. Project started off with not much in the way of project management. I brought the issue up to Ryan who was quick to respond and address the issue. Our new project manager, Henry, responded quickly to our questions and whenever we noted issues from any of the subs' work. He made sure we were pleased with each step and brought back the subs as many times as was needed to make everything perfect, and even stepped in to do things himself, as needed, to move things along. I'm sure he's just as glad to be done with this project as we are! I'd recommend RWK for their dedication to their work and to their customers and to making sure their customers are 100% satisfied before signing off on the project -- and for still responding quickly thereafter when we noticed an issue and reached out to get that touched up. - Kyle Swenson We contracted with RWK to finish the family/entertainment room in our basement and redo the floors and paint in the basement entryway. We're thrilled with the results so far and are excited to get started on the second phase of the project - remodeling our kitchen, new paint, refinished hardwood and new carpet on the upper two levels. Our project manager Taylor has been great to work with and keeps us updated on each step of the project. Their subcontractors have done a great job overall, and all have been quick to respond to any change requests we've made. We'll definitely use them again when needed and will recommend to friends and family! - Kelly D Wanlass RWK has been excellent to work with. Our project Manager was Henry. He was very knowledgeable, responsive and flexible as we worked through a custom home theater build. He did a great job of coordinating all the different elements of the project and communicating with us. He worked with us to adjust the timeline several times due to supply chain delays (not fault of RWK… just nature of current supply chain environment). We would definitely recommend them to anyone doing a home theater build out. - J.J. Phillips I had RWK construction finish my basement for me. They were fabulous. I really enjoyed working with them. Taylor was my project manager. He kept me informed about everything that was going on. He let me know if there would be any changes to the schedule so that there would be no surprises. They actually finished ahead of schedule and under budget. My favorite part is the French doors leading into the master bedroom. It is beautiful. It’s the first thing that all my friends and neighbors have commented on. I wasn’t sure what I wanted done and they gave me suggestions on some things that I could do to make it look better. I ended up putting in a laundry room in the basement. Glad they suggested it to me. The Art of Basement Remodeling: Unlocking the Full Potential November 20th, 2023 | by staylee | Posted in Basement , Construction , Expectations , Kitchen , Process , Renovation | # basement , # design , # homeoffice , # layout , # the journey , # the process , # Utah The basement, often an overlooked and underutilized space in our homes, has the potential to become one of the most valuable and versatile areas. Basement remodeling is a transformative process that can not only add functionality to your home but also increase its overall value. In this article, we’ll dive deep into the art of basement remodeling, exploring design ideas, usage options, and the step-by-step transformation process. Get ready to discover the hidden gem beneath your feet. Designing the Dream Basement: Assessing Your Needs : Before diving into basement remodeling, it’s essential to identify your goals. Are you looking for additional living space, a home office, a cozy family room, or perhaps a guest suite? Understanding your needs will shape the entire remodeling process. Layout and Space Planning : The layout of your basement can greatly impact its functionality. Work with a professional designer to create a well-thought-out floor plan that maximizes the available space and complements your vision. Lighting and Color : Basements tend to lack natural light, so thoughtful lighting design is crucial. Incorporate a combination of ambient, task, and accent lighting to create a warm and inviting atmosphere. Choose light, neutral colors to make the space feel open and airy. Finishing Materials : Selecting the right materials is key to achieving the desired look and feel. Consider moisture-resistant flooring options, such as vinyl, laminate, or engineered wood, to ensure durability in a potentially damp environment. For walls, drywall, paneling, or creative wall treatments can transform the space. Usage Options for Your Basement: Family Retreat : Create a comfortable family room with plush seating, a media center, and a play area for the kids. This space can be perfect for movie nights, game days, or simply unwinding after a long day. Home Office : Design a quiet and productive workspace in your basement. A well-lit office with customized storage solutions can help you stay organized and focused. Guest Suite : Turn your basement into a welcoming guest suite with a bedroom, bathroom, and sitting area. It’s an excellent way to accommodate visitors while maintaining privacy. Home Gym : Design a basement gym with rubber flooring, mirrors, and all the equipment you need to stay active and healthy year-round. The Basement Remodeling Process: Planning and Permits : Start by creating a detailed plan that outlines your goals, budget, and timeline. Obtain the necessary permits to ensure your remodel complies with local building codes. Foundation and Structural Work : Inspect and address any foundation or structural issues. Waterproofing is crucial to prevent moisture problems. Framing and Insulation : Create the framework for your basement layout, including walls and partitions. Proper insulation is essential for temperature control and energy efficiency. Electrical and Plumbing : Install or update electrical wiring, outlets, and plumbing as needed. This step is critical, especially if you’re adding a bathroom or kitchenette. Drywall and Finishes : Finish the walls and ceilings with drywall, and then move on to flooring, trim, and paint. Lighting and Fixtures : Install lighting fixtures and plumbing fixtures. Pay attention to details like switches, outlets, and faucets to ensure functionality and aesthetics. Furniture and Decor : Finally, furnish and decorate your basement according to its designated purpose. Add personal touches and create a space that reflects your style. Taking The Journey Basement remodeling is a journey that can unlock the full potential of your home. By carefully planning the design, considering various usage options, and following a systematic remodeling process, you can transform your basement into a valuable and enjoyable space. Whether you’re seeking additional living space, a functional home office, or a cozy retreat, your basement can become the heart of your home. These are the top three mistakes many of homeowners tend to make during home renovations and how to avoid these pitfalls to ensure your dream home becomes a reality! Before After Underestimating the Budget: We get it – you want your renovation to be cost-effective, but lowballing the budget is a dangerous game. One of the biggest mistakes homeowners make is underestimating the actual costs involved in a renovation project. Remember, it’s not just about the materials; labor, unforeseen repairs, and permits can all add up quickly. Before starting, sit down and plan your budget realistically. Research the average costs for similar projects and set aside a contingency fund for unexpected surprises. Trust us, you’ll thank yourself later when you’re not scrambling to find extra funds mid-project. Ignoring the Importance of Proper Planning: Ah, impatience – the enemy of successful renovations! Rushing into a project without proper planning is like building a house of cards during a hurricane. Take the time to create a solid plan before swinging that sledgehammer. Measure and sketch your ideas, consult with professionals, and envision the end result. Think about the flow, functionality, and aesthetics. A well-thought-out plan not only saves time and money but also helps avoid costly mistakes and rework. So, go on, grab that notebook and sketch out your dream renovation! Neglecting to Research Contractors: You wouldn’t trust your car to just any mechanic, right? The same goes for your home! Choosing the right contractor can make or break your renovation experience. Many homeowners make the mistake of going with the first contractor they come across or opting for the cheapest option. Big no-no! Research multiple contractors, read reviews, and ask for referrals from friends and family. Interview them and ensure they have proper licenses and insurance. Remember, you’re inviting these folks into your home, so it’s crucial to find someone reliable, skilled, and trustworthy. In conclusion, renovating your home is a fantastic opportunity to create your perfect living space, but it’s essential to avoid these top three mistakes. Accurate budgeting, thorough planning, and careful contractor selection are key to a successful renovation. Answering these questions will guide the rest of the project: 1. Define Your Goals and Priorities: The first thing a homeowner should think about when considering a renovation is to clearly define their goals and priorities. Ask yourself why you want to renovate and what you hope to achieve through the process. Are you looking to increase the functionality of a specific area, enhance the aesthetics, or add value to your property? Understanding your objectives will help guide your decision-making throughout the renovation process. 2. Set a Realistic Budget: Renovations can quickly become expensive, so it’s crucial to establish a realistic budget early on. Consider how much you are willing to invest in the renovation and determine if it aligns with your goals. Research the average costs of similar projects and consult with professionals to get a better understanding of the financial implications. Remember to include a contingency fund for unexpected expenses that may arise during the renovation. Assess the Scope of the Project: Before diving into a renovation, it’s essential to assess the scope of the project. Determine which areas of your home require renovation and prioritize them based on your goals and budget. Consider whether you want to focus on a single room, multiple rooms, or even an entire home renovation. Understanding the scope will help you plan the timeline, resources, and potential disruptions to your daily life. 4. Research and Gather Inspiration: Once you have a clear understanding of your goals, budget, and scope, it’s time to gather inspiration. Research various renovation ideas, styles, and trends that align with your vision. Explore home improvement websites, magazines, social media platforms, and even visit showrooms or open houses to get a sense of what you like and dislike. This research will help you communicate your preferences effectively to contractors and designers. 5. Find Reliable Professionals: Renovations often require the expertise of professionals, such as contractors, architects, or interior designers. Take the time to find reliable and experienced professionals who can bring your vision to life. Seek recommendations from friends, family, or neighbors, and don’t hesitate to ask for references or view their previous work.
